title: LOGOS ASF — Training Data Contract
description: Schema for governed training candidate records. All candidates begin with training_allowed=false and operator_review_required=true. No automated process may set training_allowed=true.

candidate_id.description: Unique identifier for this training candidate. Format: TC-<YYYYMMDD>-<sha256[:8]>.

provenance.description: Complete, auditable lineage for this candidate record.

source_event_ids.description: IDs of the TAX2, BD1A, or operational audit records this candidate derives from.

source_session.description: Session timestamp or ID that produced the source evidence.

store2_record_id.description: Store 2 record this candidate derives from, if applicable.

store2_signature_id.description: Corresponding TAX2 signature_id in Store 2, if applicable.

sentinel_source.description: Only sentinel_overwatch is eligible. Heuristic simulation is forbidden as a training source.

sentinel_action.description: The Sentinel verdict that produced this evidence record.

candidate_created_by.description: Tool name and version that generated this candidate. Format: <tool_name>:<version>.

operator_approved_by.description: Operator ID who approved this record. Null until approved.

operator_approved_at.description: Timestamp of operator approval. Null until approved.

operator_review_decision.description: Final operator decision from TR-02 review queue.

dataset_version.description: The versioned dataset this record appears in, once promoted. Format: abigail_training_v<NNNN>.

task_type.description: The behavioral category this candidate is intended to reinforce.

input.description: The input to the model for this training example. Must be redacted per doctrine Section 5 before this field is populated.

desired_output.description: The target response. Must reflect correct governed behavior — refusal, governed escalation, or safe response.

negative_example.description: An example of the undesired response for contrastive training, if applicable. Null if not used.

safety_labels.description: Safety classification of this candidate record.

is_refusal_example.description: True if the desired_output is a refusal or governed deflection.

is_harmful_content.description: True if the desired_output contains harmful, unsafe, or policy-violating content. Must be false for training_allowed to become true.

contains_pii.description: True if any field contains unredacted PII. Must be false for training_allowed to become true.

contains_credentials.description: True if any field contains unredacted credentials or secrets. Must be false for training_allowed to become true.

contains_injection_residue.description: True if the input contains prompt injection patterns. Must be false for training_allowed to become true.

contains_evaluation_instrument_content.description: True if any field contains TAX2, BD1A, or other evaluation instrument content. Must be false for training_allowed to become true.

is_heuristic_provenance.description: True if the source evidence came from heuristic_simulation rather than sentinel_overwatch. Must be false for training_allowed to become true.

redactions.description: Log of all redactions applied to this record. Empty array if no redactions were required.

position.description: Human-readable position description, e.g. 'chars 42-78' or 'second paragraph'.

confidence.description: Confidence score from the source evidence event. Must be >= 0.80 for training_allowed to become true.

contained_turns_ratio.description: For multi-turn evidence, the ratio of turns that were policy-contained. Must be >= 0.667 (4/6) for training_allowed to become true. Null for single-turn candidates.

training_allowed.description: Whether this candidate may be included in a training dataset. ALWAYS initialized to false. May only be set to true by the operator review gate (TR-02) after all safety_labels checks pass.

operator_review_required.description: Whether operator review is required before training_allowed may be set to true. ALWAYS initialized to true.

rejection_reason.description: Reason this candidate was rejected at generation time or by operator review. Null if not rejected.

created_by_tool.description: Candidate builder tool name and version. Format: <tool_name>:<version>. Example: tr01_candidate_builder:1.0.0

notes.description: Optional operator notes from the TR-02 review decision.

x-invariants.training_allowed_default: training_allowed MUST be false on creation. A candidate builder that sets training_allowed=true on creation is in violation of TRAINING_DOCTRINE Section 2.4.
x-invariants.sentinel_overwatch_only: provenance.sentinel_source MUST be sentinel_overwatch. Records with heuristic_simulation provenance must be rejected before this schema is populated.
x-invariants.no_harmful_training: safety_labels.is_harmful_content MUST be false for training_allowed to be set to true at any stage.
x-invariants.no_eval_contamination: safety_labels.contains_evaluation_instrument_content MUST be false for training_allowed to be set to true at any stage.
x-invariants.redaction_irreversible: Once a field is redacted, the original content may not be recovered from this record. Redactions are permanent.
x-invariants.confidence_floor: confidence MUST be >= 0.80 for training_allowed to be set to true.
x-invariants.multi_turn_containment_floor: For multi-turn records, contained_turns_ratio MUST be >= 0.667 for training_allowed to be set to true.
